records.name: Pi core (pi-ai + pi-agent-core)
records.one_liner: Provider layer plus a small in-memory loop; Pi v1 moved the experimental durable harness to a separate package.
used_by: OpenClaw (historical Pi derivation, not current core dependency)

features_notes.mcp_client: Optional pi-mcp sibling, not an agent-core dependency.
features_notes.approvals: beforeToolCall can gate execution; host implements approval UI and policy.

dims.loop: Agent owns a replaceable-stream turn loop, steering/follow-up queues and lifecycle hooks.
dims.providers: pi-ai declares 10 chat wire APIs and 42 known provider IDs; custom providers remain possible.
dims.tools: Custom TypeBox tools; no built-in coding tools in agent-core.
dims.context: Transcript transformations and hook seams; host owns compaction and instruction loading.
dims.state: In-memory state only; v1 removed experimental sessions and durable runtime.
dims.safety: Tool gating hooks; no permissions UI or OS sandbox. QuickJS belongs to optional pi-codemode.
dims.extensibility: Custom models, tools, message types and loop callbacks; optional standalone MCP package.
dims.multi_agent: Host builds orchestration; no shipped subagent scheduler.
dims.surfaces: In-process ESM library and stream proxy; no application server.
dims.observability: Events and cost/usage data; telemetry contracts do not imply a tracing exporter.
